description: Curation policy that tools/build.mjs enforces. Decisions come from the Phase 2 research (research/report.md, section 6).

paused.reason: Two-Tone is above the award range (22.9% of the library against 12.9% of exact award pairs). Growth is paused until the Neutral and Image-Led gaps are addressed; existing directions stay.
Light + Muted is above the award range (14.6% of the library against at most 8.6% of exact award pairs). Growth is paused until the Neutral and Image-Led gaps are addressed; existing directions stay.

prompts.note: Hue balance is a prompt for future curation, not a target. Against award chromatic colors the library leans violet (28.3% against 17.2%), is light on orange-red (13.2% against 25.7%) and has no magenta (0% against 5.0%). Award frequency says nothing about which hues suit a brief.
Foundation and saturation shares are not adjusted on their own. They move only as a side effect of filling the Neutral and Image-Led gaps.
